name: Wave Director
description: Runs enemy waves on a Multiplayer Server scene. The server owns the wave seed, checks every hit and keeps each enemy's health; every player's game builds the same spawns from the waves table in Game Config, so a wave costs no network traffic.

changelog.notes: Initial release: the same wave plan built on every player's game, server-owned enemy health with rate-limited hit and bite checks, and wave counts read from the Game Config waves table
